rows.note: Use this everyday choice when the wistfulness is about missing a person, place, or past time.

example.english: I sometimes feel wistful because I really miss the village where I lived as a child.
example.traditional: 我有時真係好掛住細個住嗰條村。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 si4 zan1 hai6 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 sai3 go3 zyu6 go2 tiu4 cyun1

rows.note: Use this when the wistfulness is specifically nostalgic longing for the past or for someone absent.

example.english: Every Chinese New Year, I feel wistful about the days when the whole family ate reunion dinner together.
example.traditional: 每逢過年，我都會懷念以前一家人食團年飯嘅日子。
example.jyutping: mui5 fung4 gwo3 nin4 ngo5 dou1 wui5 waai4 nim6 ji5 cin4 jat1 gaa1 jan4 sik6 tyun4 nin4 faan6 ge3 jat6 zi2

rows.note: Use this for a more melancholy and reflective kind of wistfulness rather than straightforward missing.

example.english: Walking through the old campus alone at dusk, I cannot help feeling wistful.
example.traditional: 黃昏獨自走過舊校園，我心裏不免有幾分惆悵。
example.jyutping: wong4 fan1 duk6 zi6 zau2 gwo3 gau6 haau6 jyun4 ngo5 sam1 leoi5 bat1 min5 jau5 gei2 fan1 cau4 zoeng3
